column1: # Core disease names (the one word left of "<word> syndrome/disease") that are not recorded as disease mentions,
# because in notes they are usually ordinary words ("Parents are 2nd cousins" is not Cousin syndrome).
# Built once from the OMIM and ORPHA disease names in phenotype.hpoa 2026-09-02: lowercase entries of Webster's 2nd International (web2,
# public domain) with wordfreq 3.1.1 English Zipf frequency >= 3.5. Kept as mentions (eponyms
# written alone in notes): gilbert, lynch, turner, usher. Family and relationship words are excluded in code.
